title: The lavender coastal train
alt: A lavender train curves past bougainvillea and Mediterranean houses above turquoise water.
description: A panoramic gouache scene combining a coastal railway, architecture and lush foreground planting.
prompt: An elegant panoramic gouache painting of a lavender passenger train curving along a Mediterranean coastal railway. Coherent connected carriages and continuous rails follow the coast, lush pine trees and bright bougainvillea fill the foreground, pastel houses and a stone viaduct recede above turquoise water. Rich hand-painted texture and nuanced shadows, expressive but readable architecture, no legible lettering.
